chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
F minor sliding into F major and back
4/4 march that keeps skipping like a stuck record
a warped music box and an out-of-tune honky-tonk piano playing the march
wobbling tape-speed pitch bends on the melody
a wheezing harmonium chord holding underneath every bar
a lopsided clock tick and a tuba that keeps losing its place
comic, unravelling, dizzy, a joke told too many times
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
seamless transition back to the theme
